# connectors_kubernetes v1

## The system as a graph

```mermaid
flowchart TB
```

A command is accepted by the component that owns its context, emits the events one of its outcomes declares, and a dashed edge is a binding carrying an event into the next command. Design §9 begins one step earlier, at the actor who invokes the first command, and so does this graph: a solid edge out of an actor is a grant, and an actor drawn with no edge at all may invoke nothing — which is something the model says, not an arrow somebody forgot.

## Bounded contexts

- **[contexts](./domains/connectors_kubernetes-contexts.md)** (`connectors_kubernetes.contexts`) — Kubernetes-owned projection of the contexts of the kubeconfig a local connection was configured with. Two types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[discovery](./domains/connectors_kubernetes-discovery.md)** (`connectors_kubernetes.discovery`) — Kubernetes-owned discovery profile, recognizer inputs and partition coordinates. Five types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[exec_credentials](./domains/connectors_kubernetes-exec_credentials.md)** (`connectors_kubernetes.exec_credentials`) — Kubernetes-owned exec credential plugin binding, its kubeconfig selection, the credential lifetime it observes and the refusals of one plugin run. Seven types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[helm](./domains/connectors_kubernetes-helm.md)** (`connectors_kubernetes.helm`) — Kubernetes-owned release-storage coordinates, revision observations and redacted content projections. Six types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[logs](./domains/connectors_kubernetes-logs.md)** (`connectors_kubernetes.logs`) — Kubernetes-owned pod log selection, line observations and truncation accounting of pods.logs. Six types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[mutations](./domains/connectors_kubernetes-mutations.md)** (`connectors_kubernetes.mutations`) — Kubernetes-owned conditional Deployment restart preparation values. Six types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[permissions](./domains/connectors_kubernetes-permissions.md)** (`connectors_kubernetes.permissions`) — Kubernetes-owned exact permission target tuple. One type, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.
- **[reads](./domains/connectors_kubernetes-reads.md)** (`connectors_kubernetes.reads`) — Kubernetes-owned read selections - resource kinds, single-object coordinates, configured namespace observations, Deployment rollout history, cluster nodes and configured custom resources. Seven types, no entities, no views, no commands, no events, no errors and no actors.

## Components

A component is a unit of ownership, not a deployment. How many of each runs, and what each needs, is [the topology](./topology.md).
